title: The Silent Song of the North
explanation: Ravi follows a song he has never heard to a city whose name he does not know.
content:
In the north, snow swallows sound. Ravi learned this on a deserted platform, where his words vanished the moment they left his mouth, as if never spoken at all.

And yet there was a song. He did not hear it; he felt it. In the middle of his chest, like a forgotten name.

With every step the city drew a little closer and a little further away. Perhaps what he sought was not a place, but a moment.
